annotations.title: Employment tribunal time limit calculator (3 or 6 months; Acas early conciliation)

description: Works out the last day to present an employment tribunal claim in England and Wales: 3 months less one day, or 6 months less one day where the relevant date is on or after 1 October 2026 (Employment Rights Act 2025 s.152 and Sch 12; S.I. 2026/954 reg 4; breach of contract by S.I. 2026/759), for unfair dismissal, discrimination, unlawful deductions, holiday pay, whistleblowing detriment, breach of contract, redundancy pay and equal pay, with Acas early conciliation (the clock-stop and the one-month rule) applied. Weekends and bank holidays do not move the date. It explains how a late claim can still be heard (not reasonably practicable, or just and equitable) but never predicts it, and never advises whether to claim.

continuing.description: "discrimination": conduct extending over a period (start is its end); "deductions" or "detriment": a series (start is the last in it).

dayA.description: Optional: Day A, the day Acas received the early conciliation notification (YYYY-MM-DD).

dayB.description: Optional: Day B, the day the early conciliation certificate was received (YYYY-MM-DD).

ending.description: "unfair-dismissal" (and where it matters): how the employment ended, for the effective date of termination: "notice" (With notice (worked, or on garden leave)), "summary" (Without notice, or with pay in lieu of notice), "fixed-term" (A fixed-term contract ended and was not renewed).

equalPayCase.description: "equal-pay": the case in the EqA 2010 s.129(3) table: "standard" (A standard case), "stable" (A stable work case (a series of contracts)), "concealment" (A concealment case), "incapacity" (An incapacity case).

interimRelief.description: "unfair-dismissal": an application for interim relief is to be made (7 days, s.128(2)).

noEdt.description: "contract": there is no effective date of termination, so start is the last day worked.

presented.description: Optional: the day the claim was or will be presented, to check it is in time (YYYY-MM-DD).

start.description: The day the time limit runs from: "unfair-dismissal": the effective date of termination; "discrimination": the date of the act complained of; "deductions": the date of payment of the wages; "holiday": the date the payment should have been made or the leave allowed; "detriment": the date of the act or failure to act; "contract": the effective date of termination; "redundancy": the relevant date; "equal-pay": the last day of the employment (YYYY-MM-DD).
